name: PA-02
label: Safe D

key_factors: D+19 district lean in Philadelphia-area seat
Incumbent Brendan Boyle running with $5.6M cash on hand
Republican challenger Jessica Arriaga has no reported fundraising
Prediction markets price Democratic win at ~97%
model.rationale: The district's D+19 lean, Boyle's incumbency and large financial advantage, and an underfunded Republican challenger all point to a safe Democratic hold, and markets agree at roughly 97%.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a dramatically tighter race or major outside spending against Boyle would be the first sign of movement.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Brendan Boyle seeks another term in this heavily Democratic Philadelphia-area district, where the partisan lean favors his party by about nineteen points. He enters the general election with a large war chest of over $5.5 million and no outside groups spending against him.

Republican challenger Jessica Arriaga has reported no fundraising, leaving her with few visible resources to close the gap in a seat this favorable to Democrats. Prediction markets price a Boyle win at roughly 97%, and no expert raters flag the race as competitive. All available evidence points to a safe Democratic hold.
